title: Writing / Style / Quotes and quotation marks
slide_intent: Distinguish quoted words from surrounding punctuation so meaning and language-specific conventions remain clear.
strategic_value: Explicit English rules with a localization exception can help Duolingo maintain consistency without imposing English punctuation on every language.
demonstration: The upper comparison covers punctuation inside and outside quotations; a lower group shows when a reporting phrase requires a preceding comma.
practical_value: Identify the language, whether punctuation belongs to the quote and whether the preceding words introduce speech.

content_islands.name: Guidance column
content_islands.spec: Place the quotation-marks heading and short framing note at left.

content_islands.name: Worked examples
content_islands.spec: Put English punctuation guidance and three paired examples above the reporting-clause rule and two checked examples.

reference_purposes.Application: The examples distinguish quoted words, quoted questions and reporting clauses.
reference_purposes.Constraint: English periods and commas go inside quotes; other marks go outside unless part of the quotation. Localized copy follows the relevant language’s conventions, and a reporting phrase introducing a quote takes a comma.

ingredient.name: Quotation punctuation
ingredient.role: Clarify quoted meaning while respecting language conventions.
ingredient.application: Apply the displayed English inside/outside rules and reporting-clause comma; follow other languages’ conventions in localization.
ingredient.scope: Historical official guidelines from the 2024–2025 archived snapshot; this records the displayed guidance, not current Duolingo product behavior.
